name: Shinagawa General Civic Hall (Curian)
accessSummary: Oimachi Station (JR Keihin-Tohoku Line / Tokyu Oimachi Line / Rinkai Line): about 2 min walk / Aomonoyokocho Station (Keikyu Line): about 15 min walk / Samezu Station (Keikyu Line): about 10 min walk
hours: Open 9:00-21:30 (reception 9:00-20:00). The time slots are morning 9:00-12:00 / afternoon 13:00-17:00 / night 18:00-21:30, and usage time includes setup and cleanup. Closed during the year-end and New Year holidays (December 29 to January 3).
notice: Use of the facility mainly for profit-making purposes is not permitted. Use for selling goods, concluding contracts, etc. is not approved (except for collecting admission fees in the Large Hall, Small Hall and Event Hall).

rooms.name: Large Hall
rooms.note: About 1,694㎡. Fixed seating for 1,074 on a single slope. Main stage is 15 m wide x 18.5 m deep x 8 m high. 6 wheelchair spaces, 8 parent-and-child seats, standing capacity 54.

rooms.name: Small Hall
rooms.note: 193 to 336 seats (with the proscenium stage: 9 m wide x 7 m deep x 4.5 m high, 285 seats). Variable stage. 4 wheelchair spaces, standing capacity 65.

rooms.name: Event Hall
rooms.note: About 560㎡ (40 m x 14 m). Up to 450 seated in rows, up to 420 at tables, about 500 standing at most. Can be divided into sections AB and CDE.

rooms.name: Large Conference Room
rooms.note: Capacity 96. Usable for meetings, performances and training, as well as ceremonies and various parties.

rooms.name: Rehearsal Room
rooms.note: Capacity 35. Indoor shoes required. No heels or tap shoes.

rooms.name: Tea Room (Japanese-style room)
rooms.note: A Japanese-style room (18 tatami mats) with a tea room (sanjo-daime) and a Japanese garden. For tea ceremony use only.

ops.vehicleRules: The roads around the hall are narrow and parking or stopping is not allowed because it obstructs the operation of route buses. The waiting line for the parking lot has been obstructing route buses, and visitors are advised to come by train or bus.
ops.parking: The B1F parking lot has 203 spaces, with a maximum vehicle height of 2.05 m. It is open 8:30-23:00, and vehicles cannot enter or exit from 23:00 to 8:30. The fee is 220 yen per 30 minutes every day, with a maximum of 1,700 yen per day (until 24:00). It is shared with the commercial facility, so it is especially crowded on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays.
ops.waitingRooms: The Large Hall has 5 dressing rooms: Dressing Room 1 (about 62㎡, capacity 20), Dressing Room 2 (about 43㎡, capacity 16), Dressing Room 3 (about 23㎡, a 12-mat tatami Japanese-style room, capacity 4), and Dressing Rooms 4 and 5 on the 8F (about 20㎡ each, capacity 4, with unit bath). Dressing Rooms 1 to 5 for the Small Hall are on B1F. Dressing rooms are charged separately (e.g., Large Hall Dressing Room 1: morning 1,400 yen / afternoon 2,100 yen / night 2,800 yen).
